_doc: E3-6a v0: the dungeon stand-ins the autoplayer (E3-6b) resolves raids with, through tests/autoplay/standin_resolver.gd (BALANCE §8, IDLE §8). Read by the resolver and the autoplayer only, never by scripts/sim/. Every number comes from the dungeon unit's raw rows at afb8dab (reports/dungeon in the run directory; each entry's `source` names its file, iteration and seeds), except where a source says GUESS. The run's manager's rulings: loot and outcome rates are the frozen bot's at score 70 (standins-raw-afb8dab.tsv, iter grade-standins); deaths and durations are the typical human's (score 70, delay 1.0, read 1.0, draw 0.7; calibration-dd-raw.tsv), the death rate pooled over seeds 20-39 (hb70d10) and 40-59 (the grading pass, grade-*-human rep 0) where both exist; death_rate_frozen is by_tier.<T>.70's for E3-6b's one sensitivity pass. Per entry: death_rate (human) and death_rate_frozen; duration_s (the median of the human's per-run estimate, the grading pass) and duration_s_frozen (the frozen bot's median scene seconds); death_t_frac (a death ends the run at death_t_frac x duration_s: the median human estimate of the died rows over that of all the rows, the same rows as death_rate); mean_loot (the frozen bot's warden_beaten rows, per kind, without the chest's guaranteed husk and first-clear blueprint, which the resolver adds from the seed's chest_husk and first_clear); kept_frac (what a death banks of mean_loot, per kind: the 27 died rows at tier pooled); mass.won / mass.died (killed_frac: killed_living_mass over the seed's living mass; raised_per_living_unit: raised_count over living_start, the living units at the start; garrison_survive_frac and raised_survivors_per_living_unit: allies_end less the party standing and the starters, the garrison taken in counted first, then the rest per living unit; mass.died is the 27 pooled died rows in every entry); party_lost_per_member (a party member's chance to be lost on a win: party_lost per won row over the party size); revives (measured: 0.0, the profile seeds carry no phylactery charge; the resolver's revive comes from the seed). The rows carry no raised, chaff or garrison mass, so those are GUESSes in the resolver (BALANCE §8). Rounded to 3 places.

held._doc: No row raids a held fort, so a held fort's raid is the tier's own entry with GUESSes (the run's manager's ruling 4): death_rate and death_rate_frozen x death_rate_mult, duration_s x duration_mult, and party_lost_per_member x party_lost_mult (the same reading: a short run with no warden room). Loot is RaidLoot.held_clear's (loot.json held_clear, yield-scaled); a death banks nothing (the clear's roll comes at the clear). The clear ends retreated and kills exactly the seed's living (STATE-API notes for api-request #10, so the writeback raises counter_garrison_cleared); its raises and survivors are the tier's mass.won ratios, a death's mass.died.
